messages:
morgan: Quicknote: fresh Expo + our JS SDK is failing on Android Hermes during `expo start --dev-client`. Crash happens only when using default import. Error: `TypeError: globalThis.crypto is undefined` and later `TypeError: body.getReader is not a function`. Repro in 5 min.

morgan: Repro steps I used:
1) `npx create-expo-app rw-rn && cd rw-rn`
2) `yarn add @redwood/inference`
3) modify App.tsx: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` then `useEffect(()=> Redwood.generate(...))`
4) `expo run:android --variant Debug` -> Metro/JS crash on device.

ash: Thanks. Two separate issues: 1) crypto shim order (polyfill must run before SDK import), 2) streaming transport assumes WHATWG streams. Hermes doesn't provide getReader. For quick unblock add at top of App.tsx: `import 'react-native-get-random-values'; import 'react-native-quick-crypto-shim';` then `const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference/dist/cjs');` That got me past the crash on Android emulator.

lee: FYI on typings: requiring CJS path breaks `esModuleInterop` consumers with `export default` vs `module.exports =`. TS server warns but runtime works. We should avoid telling users to require a subpath. Better to provide dual-typing entrypoint and fix `exports` so TS resolves to correct .d.ts for the RN condition. I can draft a PR to add `"react-native": { "types": "dist/rn/index.d.ts" }` under `exports` and include a small ambient file that re-exports the same API with proper default vs named shapes.

samera: There's also an auth retry bug I can repro in the sample app: when token refresh happens we do a streaming retry to the /auth endpoint, but in RN the body becomes an already-consumed ReadableStream so the retry sends an empty body the second time, which triggers a 400 and then infinite retry loop. Minimal test in samples/auth-retry shows a repeated POST.

ash: Good catch. For the patch I'm going to: - detect `Response.prototype.body && typeof Response.prototype.body.getReader === 'function'` and only use streaming-mode if true; otherwise buffer request/response during auth flows. - add a feature flag for `SDK_RN_POLYFILL` that enables a tiny loader: `if (process.env.SDK_RN_POLYFILL) require('./runtime/rn-shims')`.

morgan: Can we also ship a sample `expo/metro.config.js` snippet in the repo? The common ask is "how to get Metro to prefer our CJS in dev". Maybe a small helper `scripts/metro-resolve-rn.js` that apps can copy.

ash: Will add a `examples/expo/metro.config.js` with resolver `mainFields: ['react-native', 'browser', 'module', 'main']` and an `exports` condition for `react-native`. That should make Metro pick RN entry rather than module.

lee: I wrote a tiny TS declaration (dist/rn/index.d.ts) and a CI job `expo-ci` that runs `yarn && expo prebuild && tsc -p tsconfig.json`. Opened PR #2842 with the types change + CI.

samera: I filed internal bug INF-4021 for the auth retry and linked the sample app. I also attached a failing `jest` test that simulates RN fetch semantics.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: published 0.9.8-rc.2 to npm tag `rn-fixes` (sha: def456)

morgan: Tested rc.2 on device: quickstart boots, calls succeed, and auth retry no longer loops. TS server still reports a hint but PR #2842 should fix it. Thanks all.

ash: I'll add a Quickstart note under "React Native / Expo" with the minimal polyfill lines and link to #2842 once merged. We should also add an e2e smoke to the release checklist: run `examples/expo` on CI emulator to catch regressions.

morgan: Sounds good, marking resolved. Reopen if anyone sees further failures. Thanks!
